title: Strength for today
text: Be strong and courageous. The Lord your God is with you wherever you go. Lift your head; this walk is worship. (Joshua 1:9)

title: Keep going in grace
text: Let us run with endurance the race set before us, looking to Jesus. One faithful step at a time; heaven cheers you on. (Hebrews 12:1-2)

title: I can do all things
text: I can do all things through him who strengthens me. (Philippians 4:13)

title: Rise up
text: This is the day the Lord has made; rejoice and be glad in it. Shake off yesterday's heaviness and walk into today with hope. (Psalm 118:24)

title: Wait on the Lord
text: But they who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles; they shall run and not be weary; they shall walk and not faint. (Isaiah 40:31)

title: You are equipped
text: God has not given you a spirit of fear but of power and love and self-control. The task ahead is smaller than the Christ within you. (2 Timothy 1:7)

title: Be of good courage
text: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who wait for the Lord! (Psalm 31:24)

title: Morning mercies
text: His mercies are new every morning; great is his faithfulness. Yesterday's failures do not define today's walk. Begin again with joy. (Lamentations 3:22-23)

title: The joy of the Lord
text: The joy of the Lord is your strength. (Nehemiah 8:10)

title: Press on
text: Forgetting what lies behind and straining forward to what lies ahead, press on toward the goal. Every step in faith counts. (Philippians 3:13-14)
